m0x89vbq.sourceDescription: Instantly add a touch of class to your home this Christmas with the 5ft pre-lit Green Italian Pencilimo tree. The perfect choice for those looking to make a statement this festive season, this trendy 5ft pencil Christmas tree works great as both a main feature and as an additional tree. Prefer an unlit version? Not only do our Green Pencilimo trees save space, they're also cheaper than our full-size counterparts, require fewer decorations for full coverage, and they can be assembled in no time. The pronged, delicate branches also add extra elegance to the final finish of this stunning slim Christmas tree. Picture shows 7ft tree in our range. qk5pjt95.sourceDescription: Looking to give your home a standout festive centrepiece? This collapsible Christmas tree brings instant, eye-catching holiday magic to any space. Boasting full, shimmering flashing tinsel, it creates a gorgeous focal point and beautifully completes the look of your living room corner. Simple to put together, just put together the tinsel, support tubes and base for quick festive styling. Designed to be foldable, it allows for fast set-up and space-saving storage once the celebrations are over. At a perfect height for living rooms and shop displays, the sparkly tinsel finish offers a distinctive twist on traditional Christmas trees, while the robust anti-tip base keeps the tree stable and securely upright. Colour: Green Material: PET Overall Hieght: 120cm Keep away from naked flames, candles and other heat sources. Place the tree on a stable and level surface to prevent it from tipping over. Keep small parts and decorations out of reach of young children. Do not use if any parts are damaged. SYL Moda Trading LTD, Po Box 148, Manchester, M266BJ, United Kingdom

mxk44xwt.sourceDescription: Bring timeless greenery to your décor with this artificial 60cm real touch foliage heart wreath with green velvet bow. Beautifully shaped into a romantic heart, this statement wreath is filled with lush, layered foliage designed with real touch technology for an incredibly lifelike look and feel. The rich mix of greenery creates natural depth and texture, making it a versatile piece that works effortlessly across seasons. Finished with a luxurious deep green velvet bow, this wreath adds an elegant focal point to any door, wall, or interior space. Whether styled as a welcoming entrance piece, a charming indoor accent, or part of a seasonal display, its classic design brings warmth and softness to your home all year round. Crafted for lasting beauty, this maintenance free wreath stays fresh looking without watering or upkeep, simply hang and enjoy. Bring indoors during adverse weather conditions. Wreath width: 60cm.
